what: While a cell (course or category) within a long section passes the 30% line of the screen height, the whole section backdrop plate tints to that cell’s color over .5s, and the row for that cell’s turn in the stack of rows behind it (like a giant English marquee) rises from 102% below over .5s. In gaps between cells or outside the section, the backdrop returns to its resting color and the row hides again.

options.line: Share of screen height that defines ”now”, default .3
options.--fx-color: Color each cell tints to (via the cell’s style or css)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cell (child) — give it data-key and its value is carried to the section’s data-tint so css can change text color and more
options.[data-fx-part=cover]: Overlay that appears only while tinting (e.g. photo multiply layer)
options.[data-fx-part=rows]·[data-fx-part=row]: Group of lines that rise one by one in cell order — if there are several groups, all rise together
